name: passkey_helper
description: Underchat desktop helper for WhatsApp passkey pairing.

scripts.build:dev: UNDERCHAT_PASSKEY_HELPER_CHANNEL=dev tsc --noEmit && UNDERCHAT_PASSKEY_HELPER_CHANNEL=dev electron-vite build --mode development
scripts.build:prod: UNDERCHAT_PASSKEY_HELPER_CHANNEL=prod tsc --noEmit && UNDERCHAT_PASSKEY_HELPER_CHANNEL=prod electron-vite build --mode production
scripts.package:dev: pnpm run icons && pnpm run build:dev && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --config.directories.output=release/dev
scripts.package:prod: pnpm run icons && pnpm run build:prod && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --config.directories.output=release/prod
scripts.package:win:dev: pnpm run icons && pnpm run cert:win:self-signed && pnpm run build:dev && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --win nsis --config.directories.output=release/dev
scripts.package:win:prod: pnpm run icons && pnpm run cert:win:self-signed && pnpm run build:prod && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --win nsis --config.directories.output=release/prod
scripts.package:linux:dev: pnpm run icons && pnpm run build:dev && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --linux AppImage deb --config.directories.output=release/dev
scripts.package:linux:prod: pnpm run icons && pnpm run build:prod && node scripts/package-with-signing.mjs --linux AppImage deb --config.directories.output=release/prod
